enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn onto stomach. Move arm under pillow. Remain still.
Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light.
Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Pick up bowl. Pour cereal. Pour milk. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on bedroom light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Insert card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward. Greet colleague. Pick up patient chart. Review patient notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record data.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Check phone. Says "How was your morning?" to colleague. Clear tray. Walk back to ward.

Return to ward. Check patient list. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Write reports. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update records. Answer phone. Consult with doctor. Review test results. Enter data into computer. Walk to patient room. Check IV drip. Adjust settings.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Insert key. Turn key. Push door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Pick up knife. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food. Sit down. Eat.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Stop at news. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Drink water. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Personal leisure using computer or watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Open email. Read emails. Open web browser. Browse websites. Watch video. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Continue watching. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light.
Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie on back. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Remain still.
